front: Observed from three August 2024 panoramas along Post Office Avenue. Five shop bays, gables over alternating bays, segmental ground shop arches and paired first-floor sashes.
south_anchor: Observed on August 2024 corner panorama and independent listing photo. Half-timbering wraps upper floor; two first-floor and two ground openings.
north_passage: Observed at gated passage beside No8; brick end wall, partly occluded by cinema.
rear: Aerial only. Maintain footprint and conservative blank wall; window positions not established.
roof: Aerial plus front obliques. Main longitudinal ridge and three transverse gables; pitches and chimney heights estimated. 3D unavailable.

measurement_inputs.front_rhythm: Five shop bays across 27.043 m gives mean 5.409 m; split sizes estimated near equal, checked against frontage photographs.
measurement_inputs.height_estimate: Ground shop arches ~2.9m, first-floor sill ~3.85m and top ~5.8m, timber band starts ~6.6m and eaves ~9.05m; gable rise ~2.6m. Relative proportions measured visually against repeated window spans; uncertainty ~0.4m vertical, not survey.

aerial_scale_bar.uncertainty: Endpoints manually read to roughly 5 pixels; roof overhang/parallax also affects length. Compare to mapped wall 27.043m, do not replace wall control with roof pixels.
